s01-title: Video eighteen. The rest is running code. This is work in progress.
s02-runs: What exists are thin slices that prove the mechanism, from DocType to Seata, plus three new videos: HRM, STMS and SAML SSO. Each video lists its limits; this one collects them.
s03-storage: Storage. Running: JSON B, an append-only ledger, a BMS schema, Seata. In development: a schema per module, the TCC fence table, Seata store.
s04-identity: Identity. Running: Keycloak, SAML SSO, SCIM and Wasm. In development: row-level permissions, Single Logout, SCIM Bulk, and Tier one isolated JVMs.
s05-data-ai: Data. Running: Rust CDC, MCP with personal data masked. In development: streaming, Apache Doris, autonomous agents, vector RAG.
s06-modules: HRM needs income tax, payouts and a month-end job. STMS needs a real LLM, real maps and a driver app. Audit hash chains and field encryption have not started.
s07-close: Each step runs for real before its video. The README has the roadmap. Most useful now: critiquing the DocType model and overlays.
s10-outro: Astra. One platform, every business process. Open source, MIT license.
